use default
use System.Convert
use System.Text.Encoding

url_decode(text: string) -> string is
    let bytes = LIST()
    let i mut = 0

    while i < text.length do
        if text[i] == '%' /\ i + 2 < text.length then
            bytes.add(Convert.to_byte(text[i + 1..i + 3], 16))
            i = i + 3
        else
            bytes.add(cast ubyte(text[i]))
            i = i + 1
        fi
    od

    return Encoding.utf8.get_string(bytes.to_array())
si

["http%3A%2F%2Ffoo%20bar%2F",
 "google.com/search?q=%60Abdu%27l-Bah%C3%A1",
 "%25%32%35"]
    |> each(encoded =>
        write_line("{encoded} -> {url_decode(encoded)}"))
